text:
nina-sales: FYI HeliosHealth just dropped a 50-row RFI and asked for an on-prem POC with HSM + HIPAA attestation. They want answers and a costed POC plan by Thursday. Can we triage scope now?

jordan-se: what model and perf targets are they asking for?

nina-sales: they're evaluating clinical summarization so recommended model: redwood-clinical-7b. p95 latency target <200ms for single-turn inference, throughput modest. Also they require logs never leave customer network during POC.

alex-eng: for that latency and on-prem constraint, recommend Private (on-prem) deployment with 3x H100-ish GPUs, kv-cache enabled, sticky routing. Fallback policy: only failover to customer-approved regional private cloud (no hosted). We'll need network egress rules in the contract.

lee-sec: HIPAA + BAA mandatory. We support customer-managed HSM via PKCS#11 and AWS CloudHSM integrations in Private. For the RFI: Q3 (key custody) = "customer-managed HSM supported; we can operate a dedicated HSM appliance in-customer network under customer key custody; Redwood personnel access requires documented change control." I'll attach the HIPAA attestation and SOC2 Type II.

jordan-se: rough POC pricing: 3-week POC w/ infra + eng on-call + security review = ~$18k in credits + potential 2-day onsite for network integration if needed. For production reserved capacity, propose monthly commit pricing; I'll add a row in the matrix.

nina-sales: procurement also asked for data deletion language and liability cap explanation. Legal?

sofia-legal: I have the standard termination/data-return + delete clause. We'll include: 30 days to certify deletion, proof of deletion on request, and preserved audit logs for retention period only if customer opts in. For liability, we'll use our standard clause but can escalate if they require changes.

alex-eng: here's a minimal POC config snippet to include in the RFI response:
```
model: redwood-clinical-7b
deployment: private-onprem
nodes: 3
hsm: customer-managed
batch_policy: local-low-latency
kv_cache: enabled
fallback: regional-private-cloud (explicit opt-in)
log_retention: in_customer_network_only
```

lee-sec: additional RFI notes: quarterly pen-tests OK; for attestation deliverables we'll attach SOC2 and HIPAA BAA template. Also call out that logs are encrypted in transit and at rest; we support TLS mutual auth for connections.

ops-bot: alex-eng requested onprem deployment template generation at 2026-03-21T16:40:00Z 2: template created: /infra/templates/onprem-helios-20260321.yaml :white_check_mark:

nina-sales: excellent. Action items: jordan 1 update capability matrix with POC cost, fallback behavior, and ops checklist; lee 1 populate RFI security answers and attach SOC2/HIPAA; sofia 1 provide termination+deletion clause. I'll package a customer-facing summary and send the draft to Helios by EOD Thurs. :thumbsup:

jordan-se: I'll drop the updated matrix link here when ready.

lee-sec: working on RFI answers now, will ping if we need more specifics about HSM appliance model.

sofia-legal: sending clause draft to thread in 1 hour.

nina-sales: thanks team 1 — will loop AE and shipping contacts.
